name: phorvex-services
value:
{{- if and (eq .environment "staging") (or (eq .service "brain") (eq .service "manager") (eq .service "console")) }}
spec:
  sources:
  - repoURL: https://github.com/PhorvexSecurity/operator-refactored.git
    targetRevision: 6ae89857369468d4ca39a6856d9fd55c3b5debd3
    path: '{{.chart}}'
    helm:
      releaseName: '{{.release}}'
      skipCrds: true
      valueFiles:
      - '$values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/phorvex.yaml'
      - '$values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/{{.service}}.yaml'
      - '$values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/catalogue-family.yaml'
      valuesObject:
{{- if eq .service "brain" }}
        phorvex:
          mathLab:
            capturePolicies:
            - phorvex-staging-demo/demo-api-defense
            - phorvex-staging-demo/stage-bench-defense
            captureMaxBytes: 1073741824
        mathLabStore:
          existingClaim: staging-brain-mathlab
{{- end }}
{{- if eq .service "manager" }}
        phorvex:
          mathLab:
            captureCostEvidence: true
{{- end }}
{{- if eq .service "console" }}
        phorvex:
          console:
            auth:
              grants:
                extraSubjects:
                - issuer: https://oidc.eks.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/id/B4E80A6F4AB1E51169435AFFDC706401
                  subject: system:serviceaccount:phorvex-staging:staging-brain-benchmark
                  roles:
                  - investor
                  tenants:
                  - phorvex-staging-demo
                  targets:
                  - default
                  note: Read-only source-pinned stage brain benchmark snapshot collection.
{{- end }}
  - repoURL: https://github.com/PhorvexSecurity/operator-refactored.git
    targetRevision: main
    ref: values
{{- end }}
